# DropSpace v0.3.0-preview.17 — Architecture ownership and recovery

<!-- update-summary: Preview.17 fixes stale state and projection recovery, owns and drains background work, bounds clipboard propagation and preview caching, and isolates safe staged-file imports. -->

This Preview preserves Windows 10 1809/Windows 11 x64, Dynamic Island, local-first storage, external file references, existing protocols and schemas.

- Failed projections can retry; old searches cannot replace newer navigation results; total Space counts remain accurate beyond the visible page.
- SQLite repositories share one write owner. Settings updates preserve concurrent pause and update-check changes.
- Application, update and Undo shutdown share completion and drain owned work; Overlay projection cleanup is awaited.
- Automatic cross-device clipboard uses one consumer with 16 queued events. Under sustained overload older queued events are skipped in favor of newer clipboard state. Image reads are bounded.
- Staged-file import owns validation, streaming copy, commit and cancellation cleanup outside the ViewModel. External originals are never deleted.
- Preview cache has explicit count, size and age bounds. External file changes are reflected without stale cache; deletion invalidation rejects delayed old writes; cache failures do not hide valid previews.

## Validation boundary

The final source must pass hosted Windows Core/Infrastructure/App tests, WinUI build, installer/update/uninstall, portable localized smoke and packaging before publishing. Website/Worker contract tests and public release/API verification remain separate gates. Real Windows OS/DPI/multi-monitor/OLE/accessibility, two-device network and operator-deployed Worker/browser acceptance remain **CONDITIONAL**. No measured startup, memory or frame-rate improvement is claimed. See `docs/audit/2026-09-07/architecture-audit-zh.md` for the full audit and remaining debt.

## 中文说明

Preview.17 明确数据库写入、设置变更、后台任务退出与暂存文件导入的责任边界；修复旧搜索覆盖、投影失败无法重试及总数错误。自动剪贴板传播采用单消费者和有界队列，过载时跳过较旧待发送内容。预览缓存有容量、时效与删除代际屏障，不缓存外部源的陈旧快照。保留现有功能、协议、数据库结构及原文件安全规则。

托管 Windows 构建与发布门禁不替代真机系统/DPI/OLE/无障碍、双设备网络或真实 Worker 部署验收。Preview 可能未签名；稳定通道不会自动接收此版本。
